question: What causal claim does the speaker make about coming to know the determination of the Kaula through the addressee?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have come to know something.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the addressee.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The extent or depth of that knowledge is not specified.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula.
